profile.stackAssumption: The physical stack has 2.2 um top copper, 6 um LTC-25000, 700 um EME-G730, and no continuous ground plane. Existing BASIC homogeneous microstrip/grounded-CPW equations do not model it. Any numerical results are archived hypothetical grounded-polyimide reference calculations only, not physical-stack predictions; mold resin and ungrounded multilayer CPW are not solved.

applicability.materialStatus: er and tan(delta) are illustrative constant assumptions, not verified LTC-25000 or EME-G730 broadband material properties
reasons: Physical device has no continuous ground plane, while the reference microstrip equations require one.
The 700 um EME-G730 layer and ungrounded multilayer coplanar return field are not modeled.
Broadband er and tan(delta) for both materials remain unverified.

common.curveGrid: 2001 linear points plus exact band endpoints, named sample frequencies and known stub notch frequencies; plotted on logarithmic frequency axis

rdlloss.title: Conductor and dielectric loss
rdlloss.ports: P1 west / P2 east; north/south parked
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Assumed loss tangent is frequency independent and is not a verified LTC-25000 broadband measurement.
The source uses a roughness-corrected thick-conductor approximation; it flags T < 3 skin depths.
No radiation or launch loss; extract differential loss only after calibration and mismatch checks.

rdxtalk.title: Coupled-line crosstalk
rdxtalk.ports: P1 west aggressor near; P2 north aggressor far; P3 south victim near; P4 east victim far
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
The coupled DUT model has zero metal thickness; 2.2 um copper is used in feed synthesis only.
Static Kirschning-Jansen modes with lossless lines; no dielectric/conductor loss, access bends, probe or fanout parasitics.
The 1000 um adjustable contact-centre rule is not a certification of MPI probe-body clearance.

rfleak.title: Broadside capacitive leakage
rfleak.ports: P1 west / P2 east, both top side; north/south parked
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Parallel-plate capacitance omits fringing and radiation; the source warns when plate dimensions are less than five times the gap.
The lower-layer pickup uses an access transition to the east top-side probe; the transition is outside this model.
Via-fence pitch follows lambda/20 only and predicts no shielding dB. Copper thickness is absent from the plate model.

stubtest.title: Three-port shunt-stub notch
stubtest.ports: P1 west / P2 east / P3 north at the branch end
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Ideal lossless shunt branch with an open-end correction. Tee, launch, radiation and conductor/dielectric loss are omitted.
The response is P1-to-P2 with P3 externally open or shorted; a complete three-port S matrix is not calculated.
Analytic notch locations are included in the plotting grid; a sparse uniform sweep could miss them.

trlset.title: Multiline TRL coverage
trlset.ports: P1 west / P2 east; north/south parked
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Only fitting lines are eligible. The longest quarter-wave line may exceed the 40mm default maximum at the low band edge.
A usable pair must have phase strictly between 20 and 160 degrees modulo 180. Sampled coverage is not a proof between samples.
This is a two-port west/east standard generator and does not supply a full four-head calibration for RDXTALK.

viamatch.title: Stud/via input match
viamatch.ports: P1 west only; east/north/south parked; RL/RX is an internal load
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Closed cylindrical return and homogeneous ER-filled coax segments are surrogates, not a discrete return-via electromagnetic model.
Ideal frequency-scaled lumped match and specified internal load; loss, launch parasitics, component self-resonance and fabrication tolerances are omitted.
The one-port quantity is return loss; there is no external east through port or S21 prediction.

zcoupon.title: Impedance width variation
zcoupon.ports: P1 west / P2 east; north/south parked
limits: Not a prediction for the physical ungrounded 6 um LTC-25000 / 700 um EME-G730 stack. The hypothetical continuous plane below the polyimide is absent in the real device.
Finite-thickness static microstrip cross sections, followed by ideal lossless transmission-line mismatch results.
Copper thickness changes the synthesized width and effective parameters; actual conductor/dielectric attenuation is omitted in this program.
Nominal return loss reaches the program display floor of 120dB; this is a numerical ideal, not a realizable probe measurement.
